payload.text: The smile wings carry DISTINCT per-wing vols — the counterpart to the single-vol broker strangle (ANALYTICS-SPEC §1.4, Reiswich-Wystup/Clark). `smile_wings` builds the recovered 25Δ/10Δ wings from the trial smile-strangle σ_ss as `call_vol = σ_ATM + σ_ss + ½RR` and `put_vol = σ_ATM + σ_ss − ½RR` (the risk-reversal RR splits the two wings antisymmetrically), then resolves each wing's strike at ITS OWN vol via strike_at_delta. Because call and put wings get different vols (unlike market_strangle's single vol on both strikes), the explicit broker→smile calibration step is mandatory: a non-zero RR makes the smile-strangle differ from the broker butterfly. Pure: reads ctx/atm_vol/pillar/rr/smile_strangle, returns a Result tuple, mutating nothing.
